title: Long Beach Watersports - Jet Ski Rentals
specs: Over 6 miles of protected water ride zone behind the seawall in Long Beach Bay
Must be 21 years old to rent a jetski
Must be 18 years or older to operate a jetski
Must have a valid credit or debit card, no cash accepted
Must have a valid/current ID matching credit/debit card
Maximum weight 1 rider 275 lbs, 2 riders 400 lbs
Must have an ID (driver's license or passport) to operate, USCG requirement
includes: Use of brand new SeaDoo GTX Pro jet skis
gap: Duration and price for 2 hour and full day rentals not stated
blurb: Guests rent brand new SeaDoo GTX Pro jet skis and ride in a protected 6-mile long zone behind the seawall in Long Beach Bay. Rentals are available for 1 hour, 2 hours, or a full day. No deposits are required and the jet skis hold up to 2 people with weight limits.
extraNote: No security deposits required · Arrive at least 30 minutes before rental for check-in and instruction · No switching riders once jet ski leaves dock · Check in at the dock on the water at Hotel Maya, enter main gate and follow signs to jetski parking.
